title: Cleaning administrative spatial data
text: ships administrative boundaries (country ADM0, province ADM1, district ADM2) spatial layers — Esri geodatabase, GeoPackage, folder shapefiles. geography can drive analysis made trustworthy, raw boundary exports rarely . export typically carry: invalid geometries — self-intersections bad ring topology break spatial joins; sliver artifacts — hairline holes tiny detached fragments left digitising, real geography; open-ended validity windows — enddate set sentinel year (e.g. 9999) meaning “still current”; duplicate units, admin names vary across releases. polished::process_spatial() single call reads level, standardises columns package’s canonical adm0 / adm1 / adm2 names, audits , repairs geometry, writes cleaned per-level shape year-expanded “long” shape temporal joins.

title: Cleaning administrative spatial data
text: build three layers — country, province, district — write temporary folder GeoPackages, exactly shape process_spatial() expects find disk. district layer carries interesting problems. district layer cleaner handed — five rows, four distinct districts, catalogue problems: D2 invalid (bowtie); D1 carries hairline sliver hole D3 tiny detached sliver part; D4 duplicated; four five rows open-ended (enddate year 9999).
code: # small geometry constructors ------------------------------------------------- rect <- function(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) {   sf::st_polygon(list(rbind(     c(xmin, ymin), c(xmin, ymax), c(xmax, ymax), c(xmax, ymin), c(xmin, ymin)   ))) } ring <- function(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) {   rbind(c(xmin, ymin), c(xmin, ymax), c(xmax, ymax), c(xmax, ymin), c(xmin, ymin)) }  # ADM2 districts, each with a deliberate flaw ------------------------------- # D1: a real interior hole (large) PLUS a hairline sliver hole (tiny) d1 <- sf::st_polygon(list(   ring(0, 0, 1, 1), # outer   ring(0.3, 0.3, 0.7, 0.7), # real hole  -> kept   ring(0.9, 0.9, 0.9005, 0.9005) # sliver hole -> removed )) # D2: a self-intersecting "bowtie" -> invalid, repaired by st_make_valid() d2 <- sf::st_polygon(list(rbind(   c(2, 0), c(3, 1), c(3, 0), c(2, 1), c(2, 0) ))) # D3: a multipolygon = one real part + one tiny detached sliver part d3 <- sf::st_multipolygon(list(   list(ring(4, 0, 5, 1)), # real part   -> kept   list(ring(6, 0, 6.0005, 6.0005)) # sliver part -> removed )) # D4 and its exact duplicate (same name + geometry) -> flagged d4 <- rect(0, 2, 1, 3)  shp_adm2 <- sf::st_sf(   adm0_name = "ALPHA",   adm0_guid = "g-alpha",   adm1_name = c("NORTH", "NORTH", "SOUTH", "SOUTH", "SOUTH"),   adm1_guid = c("g-an", "g-an", "g-as", "g-as", "g-as"),   adm2_name = c("D1", "D2", "D3", "D4", "D4"),   guid = c("g-d1", "g-d2", "g-d3", "g-d4", "g-d4"),   startdate = "2015-01-01",   enddate = c("9999-12-31", "9999-12-31", "2020-12-31", "9999-12-31", "9999-12-31"),   geometry = sf::st_sfc(d1, d2, d3, d4, d4, crs = 4326) )  # ADM1 provinces and ADM0 country (dissolved extents, no flaws) --------------- shp_adm1 <- sf::st_sf(   adm0_name = "ALPHA", adm0_guid = "g-alpha",   adm1_name = c("NORTH", "SOUTH"), guid = c("g-an", "g-as"),   startdate = "2015-01-01", enddate = "9999-12-31",   geometry = sf::st_sfc(rect(0, 0, 1, 1), rect(2, 0, 6, 3), crs = 4326) ) shp_adm0 <- sf::st_sf(   adm0_name = "ALPHA", guid = "g-alpha",   startdate = "2015-01-01", enddate = "9999-12-31",   geometry = sf::st_sfc(rect(0, 0, 6, 3), crs = 4326) )  # write the three layers into one folder -------------------------------------- src_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "boundaries") dir.create(src_dir, showWarnings = FALSE) sf::st_write(shp_adm0, file.path(src_dir, "world_adm0.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE) sf::st_write(shp_adm1, file.path(src_dir, "world_adm1.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE) sf::st_write(shp_adm2, file.path(src_dir, "world_adm2.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE) shp_adm2 |>   sf::st_drop_geometry() |>   dplyr::select(adm1_name, adm2_name, guid, enddate) #>   adm1_name adm2_name guid    enddate #> 1     NORTH        D1 g-d1 9999-12-31 #> 2     NORTH        D2 g-d2 9999-12-31 #> 3     SOUTH        D3 g-d3 2020-12-31 #> 4     SOUTH        D4 g-d4 9999-12-31 #> 5     SOUTH        D4 g-d4 9999-12-31 is_multipart <- function(geom) {   vapply(geom, \(g) inherits(g, "MULTIPOLYGON") && length(g) > 1L, logical(1)) }  tibble::tibble(   district = shp_adm2$adm2_name,   valid = sf::st_is_valid(shp_adm2),   multipart = is_multipart(sf::st_geometry(shp_adm2)),   open_ended = lubridate::year(as.Date(shp_adm2$enddate)) == 9999 ) #> # A tibble: 5 × 4 #>   district valid multipart open_ended #>   <chr>    <lgl> <lgl>     <lgl>      #> 1 D1       TRUE  FALSE     TRUE       #> 2 D2       FALSE FALSE     TRUE       #> 3 D3       TRUE  TRUE      FALSE      #> 4 D4       TRUE  FALSE     TRUE       #> 5 D4       TRUE  FALSE     TRUE

title: Cleaning administrative spatial data
text: cleaned district layer carries canonical adm0 / adm1 / adm2 names (renamed source *_name columns), level GUID adm2_guid, shape geometry column. Every geometry now valid: long shape turns unit’s year_start..year_end validity window one row per active year — table join point data need boundary current given year. Two rules keep compact: enumeration stops current year (open-ended 9999 units spawn thousands phantom rows); sentinel 9999 year appended every unit, records whose year unknown still match. Problems written CSVs rather silently dropped. duplicated D4 district, instance, lands duplicate-name check:

title: Downloading POLIS data
text: POLIS exposes data OData API, three quirks make naive OData client silently lose rows. polished::get_polis_data() single entry point works around three, caches results disk, resumes cleanly pull interrupted. three traps handles : Date filters year-aligned . title: Calculate polio surveillance indicators (the POLIS indicator catalogue) — calc_polio_indicators
text: cases Cleaned AFP case data, one row per case (data.frame/tibble). population Optional -15 population denominators, one row per admin unit per year (pop_guid_var, pop_year_var, pop_var). Required rate / district indicators; absent -> skipped. virus, es, sia, lab Optional cleaned analytic tables virus, environmental-surveillance, SIA human-specimen (lab) indicator families. Absent -> families skipped warning. admin_units Optional universe expected district admin units: data frame columns adm2_guid, adm0_guid, optionally adm1_guid. Build district shape create_long_shape(shape, "adm2") dplyr::distinct(sf::st_drop_geometry(shape), adm0_guid, adm1_guid, adm2_guid). Required silent-districts indicator; absent -> skipped. (run_pipeline() derives cfg$shape automatically.) indicators indicators compute: keyword "core" (default – core KPI set: NPAFP rate, condition-aware stool adequacy, EV detection rate, timely detection), "" (full registered catalogue), explicit character vector indicator codes. Anything whose source/columns unavailable skipped warning. See available_indicators(core_only = TRUE) core set. levels Admin levels report : "adm0", "adm1", "adm2". cols Named list overriding default source-column mappings, e.g. list(cases = list(class = "my_class")). See polished:::.polio_default_cols() full default map. class_var, age_var, year_var, onset_date_var Case columns (back-compat shortcuts override cols$cases). adm0_guid_var, adm1_guid_var, adm2_guid_var Case GUID columns per level. adm0_name_var, adm1_name_var, adm2_name_var Case admin-name columns. adequacy_var Case column flagging adequate stool (timing-based). invest_interval_var Case column notification->investigation days. npafp_classes, pending_classes Classification values counted NPAFP / pending (matched case-insensitively). include_pending TRUE (default) pending cases count NPAFP numerator (ufn_Indicator_NPAFP_RATE); _nopending variant separate. afp_exclude_classes Classifications excluded AFP denominator percentage indicators (default "-AFP"). pop_guid_var, pop_year_var, pop_var Column names population (defaults "adm2_guid", "year", "u15_pop"). rate_multiplier Population scale rates (default 1e5). npafp_target, npafp_warn Good / warn thresholds NPAFP rate. adequacy_target, adequacy_warn Thresholds percentage indicators. invest_timely_days Max notification->investigation days count timely (default 2). survindcat_rate_cutoff Policy NPAFP-rate cutoff used survindcat (default 2; uses region/endemic-specific cutoffs – override per run). min_pop Population rate flagged low-confidence. min_cases Case count percentage flagged low-confidence. reference_date Date capping annualisation period (default today). verbose Emit cli progress + key one-line steps (default TRUE). summary Emit full cli summary panel (coverage--family report). Default TRUE; run_pipeline() passes FALSE keep pipeline terse.
